testPolicy.text: SMU is fully test-optional. No preference is given to applicants based on whether they submit test results or not; SMU superscores the SAT and ACT. Scores are used in admission and scholarship decisions if submitted.

cost.totalIncludes: on-campus undergraduate, full-time 12-18 credit hours, fall 2026 and spring 2027: tuition 63,736 + general student fees 8,080 + housing and food 20,950 (direct 92,766) + books, supplies and loan fees 888 + transportation 1,134 + personal 1,600 (indirect 3,622) = 96,388. Summer and intersession not included.

aidPromise.text: Access SMU provides additional merit scholarships to meet full need for Texas residents who enter as full-time first-years directly from high school, receive a Federal Pell Grant and an SMU academic scholarship (University, Founders', Second Century, Distinguished or Provost), submit the FAFSA and CSS Profile, and have a family adjusted gross income of $100,000 or less (with typical assets). No university-wide full-need promise is published.

facts.text: Early Decision admitted 424 of 528 applicants (CDS 2025-26, C21), a far higher rate than the 11,459 admits from 24,053 applicants overall.

Texans and out-of-state applicants are close in number but not in admits: in fall 2025, 5,071 of 12,254 Texas applicants and 5,859 of 9,805 out-of-state applicants were admitted (437 of 1,767 international).
Very few enrolled students sent scores: only 9.4% of the fall 2025 first-years submitted the SAT and 8.6% the ACT, so the published score ranges describe a small minority.
All first-years are admitted as pre-majors in Dedman College regardless of intended major, except Art, Film (BFA), Dance, Music and Theatre, where an audition or portfolio is a critical factor.
Access SMU meets full need with extra merit scholarships for Pell-eligible Texas residents with family AGI of $100,000 or less who also earn an SMU academic scholarship.
The waiting list offered 4,249 places for fall 2025; 1,074 students accepted one and 243 were admitted.

notes: C1 totals are sums: applied 11,148 men + 12,905 women; admitted 5,217 + 6,242; enrolled 847 + 868; they match the residency table totals (24,053 / 11,459 / 1,715). The ED counts in C21 are captioned 'For the Fall 2024 entering class' in the 2025-26 form (template label). CDS C21/C22 dates: ED I 11/1 (notification 12/31), ED II 1/15 (notification 3/1), EA 11/1 (notification 12/31), not restrictive. CDS 2025-26 Part G lists tuition 63,736, fees 8,080, food and housing 20,950 under the 2026-27 heading, consistent with the Student Financial Services 2026-27 page. CDS C8F notes tests are not required for non-US citizens at high schools abroad nor for audition/portfolio BFA programs. pctSubmitting GPA 100.00 per C12.
